title: ChatHealthy FDA Product To Diagnosis Resolution
description: One document per FDA drug product in the fdaProductToDiagnosisResolution collection (EPIC-010-F-007), ChatHealthy's FDA drug collection. 1:1 with the FDA file, keyed by set_id: the FDA SPL label record enriched in place (its native fields pass through, so additionalProperties is true) with its resolved RxNorm ingredient RXCUIs and, per indication, the ICD-10-CM 3- and 4-character diagnosis codes it is on-label indicated to treat. Prescription products only; OTC is excluded. Built claims-blind by FDADrugEnrichmentTool.

set_id.description: the FDA SPL set_id; the record key

record_number.description: sequential load index used for range work

ingredient_rxcuis.description: resolved RxNorm ingredient RXCUIs (tty=IN); one for a single-ingredient drug, many for a combination

ingredient_names.description: RxNorm ingredient names positionally aligned with ingredient_rxcuis; empty string where a name is unavailable for the aligned RXCUI

resolved_by.description: the resolution tier that produced ingredient_rxcuis

description.description: the ICD-10-CM short description for icd10_code, from the catalog; null when the code is not in the loaded catalog
